Google Sign in button artwork

`google-signin-official.png` is the official light, rectangular pre-approved Sign in with Google button from https://developers.google.com/static/identity/images/branding_guideline_sample_lt_sq_lg.png. `google-signin-button.bmp` is a BMP conversion of that artwork for the native Inno Setup wizard. Do not recolor or substitute the Google G. See https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines for current branding terms.

This is UI artwork only. Catch It does not authenticate with Google in this preview build.
